Le fratture dello scafoide possono non v: Scaphoid fractures may not be visible at first: with typical pain, immobilise and re-examine.
Saper dire «nessuna frattura» è importan: Being able to say «no fracture» is as important as finding one. At the wrist check: the cortices of radius and ulna, the styloids, the three carpal arcs (Gilula) without steps, the spaces between the carpal bones (a wide scapholunate gap indicates a ligament injury) and the scaphoid. Scaphoid fracture is the one most often missed: with anatomical snuffbox pain dedicated views are needed and, if negative, immobilisation and re-examination after 10-14 days or MRI, because the risk is necrosis of the proximal pole.
